scope: Supervised public UI observations in a separate ordinary local editor; not wire or backend proof

setup.keyboard: PixelBoard, selected through normal UI using mic-with-star
setup.interaction: Human held, started and stopped voice input; no automated ambient fallback or hook/tampering
setup.editor: Separate owned ordinary editor with no manifest permissions and no forced incognito flag; SEND is consumed locally and sends nothing
setup.incognito_qualification: Removing the editor's NO_PERSONALIZED_LEARNING flag removed an incognito UI ambiguity; it is not proven to be the sole cause and does not promise provider learning behavior

build.source_pin_note: Pins describe build inputs, not a claim that uncommitted sources are integrated.

cases.interpretation: Prefix not preserved and punctuation absent; cause not isolated. This is not evidence of faithful context or of a native or Android bug.
Literal instruction text, not a polite rewrite, in this trial.

cases.user_report: The user first said Send on the empty field and perceived no visible effect; subsequently the user reported trying salut, ça va and send the message and seeing it work.
cases.interpretation: No intermediate snapshot assigns either callback to an utterance. Neither a short-command failure nor reliable performance for longer commands is established.

limits: Selection/composition offsets are values in the latest callback snapshot, not a guarantee of live state when read; selection-only changes or finishComposingText after a text update may not trigger a new snapshot.
Observations are not three semantic passes, a causal diagnosis, or a count of distinct ASR or RPC calls.
No network or wire capture: no S3Bidi or ASR route identity, full Android parity, or backend terminal proof.
Native Rust backend remains Rambler; no alternate ASR substitution.
Prior failures, signature restrictions, and USER_RESTRICTED records remain valid historical observations.
